title: Configuration-generated AI inventory
objective: Every AI system, model, agent and AI provider used in delivering or building Echelon services is recorded with owner, version, data scope and authority ceiling, generated from configuration and reconciled each release.
implementing_systems: Unbound agent capability manifest (designed, not built)
owner: Not assigned (proposed: Echelon AI governance owner)
residual_risks: Does not capture unmanaged personal AI tool use.

title: Tool broker refuses unregistered agents
objective: An agent identity absent from the inventory and capability manifest receives no tools, so unregistered AI cannot act in the product.
notes: Scope is product agents only; engineering agents run outside the product and are governed by AIA controls. 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: Replaced superseded SRC-OWASP-LLM-TOP10-2025 with SRC-OWASP-LLM-TOP10-2026; locators remapped to 2026 numbering (LLM06:2025 to LLM03:2026).

title: Adopted AI policy with encoded invariants
objective: A formally approved AI policy defines permitted uses, prohibited uses, data rules, accountable owner and exceptions, and its invariants (NoAiClearance, no agent human-authority operations) are encoded in the authority matrix.

title: Generated AI control crosswalk
objective: A crosswalk from Echelon AI controls to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A and CSA AICM is generated from the control register and published with each register version.

title: AI risk and impact assessment gate
objective: No AI use is activated, and no model, prompt, tool or data change is released, without a current recorded risk and impact assessment approved by the named owner.
owner: Not assigned (proposed: Echelon AI governance owner)

title: Subgroup error measurement for automated scoring
objective: Automated scoring or matching that affects people reports error rates by relevant subgroup at each change and at least quarterly, with thresholds approved by the accountable owner.
owner: Not assigned (proposed: sponsor compliance officer with Unbound product owner)

title: AI provider and model due diligence with version pinning
objective: AI providers are assessed as vendors with model-specific checks before use; production models are pinned and provider-initiated changes pass the frozen evaluation set before adoption.
owner: Not assigned (proposed: Echelon vendor risk owner)

title: No-training and minimal-retention AI provider terms
objective: Only AI provider offerings whose terms prohibit training on customer inputs and outputs are used with customer data; retention and human review terms are recorded and minimized.

title: AI law applicability rows in the regulatory register
objective: Each AI-specific law has an applicability determination with role, classification, facts relied on and counsel review, re-evaluated on defined triggers.
implementing_systems: Unbound regulatory applicability register (designed, not built)
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: replaced SRC-COLORADO-AI-ACT with SRC-COLORADO-SB26-189 and added SRC-EU-AI-OMNIBUS-2026 (amended EU AI Act application dates).

title: Model documentation packages and change notice
objective: Each component a customer may treat as a model has a generated documentation package and material changes are notified in advance.
implementing_systems: Folio (exists as a component system; not operated for this purpose)
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: replaced superseded SRC-SR-11-7 with SRC-SR-26-2.

title: AI transparency statement, content labeling and tenant AI disable
objective: Customers can see where AI is used, AI-generated content is labeled, and each tenant can disable AI features with deterministic functions unaffected.
implementing_systems: Unbound tool broker and tenant configuration (designed, not built)
owner: Not assigned (proposed: Echelon AI governance owner)
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: replaced SRC-COLORADO-AI-ACT with SRC-COLORADO-SB26-189.
